description: This file defines the DobbySpecGenerator class responsible for generating container specifications for application runtime environments, including configuration of mounts, environment variables, plugins, and network settings.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating container specifications for application runtime environments, including configuration of mounts, environment variables, plugins, and network settings.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Returns the working directory for the application based on configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates the container specification JSON string based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variable array for the container based on configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates the list of filesystem mounts for the container.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount JSON object for source and destination paths with specified flags.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates a mount for the resource manager socket if available.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string using libcurl's escape function.

methods.name: addHolePunchPortToSpec
methods.description: Adds a hole punch port configuration to the container spec for NAT traversal.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes the Ion memory plugin data with heap quotas.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Determines the system memory limit for the container based on configuration.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Determines the GPU memory limit for the container based on configuration.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether VPU support should be enabled based on application ID and blacklist.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of CPU cores to assign to the container.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates the RDK plugin configuration object for the container spec.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates the minidump plugin configuration for crash reporting.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates the AppService SDK plugin configuration.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates network plugin configuration for NAT or none.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates the list of classic plugins such as logging and DRM.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates the EthanLog plugin configuration for logging levels.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Placeholder for multicast socket plugin configuration.

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates Ion memory plugin configuration.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates the Thunder plugin configuration with local services URLs.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates the OpenCDM plugin configuration.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates a private data filesystem mount.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates mounts for FKPS files and additional tmpfs mount.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount configuration.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates a mount for the resource manager socket.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount JSON object.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines if GPU should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates RDK plugin configuration object.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Generates environment variables array for the container.
